== Source, printing and text-state verification (Story 386) ==
The [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-world-championship-mike-kessling-ls-something-about-this-boy/ published Players Committee decklist] was compared with the [[Media:26Worlds Kessling LS Boy Crazy.txt|wiki-hosted XML download]] and the card articles linked in the table. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114035755/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2026-world-championship-mike-kessling-ls-something-about-this-boy.html Players Committee decklist]. The download's File page attributes the XML to the forum distribution; the original forum ZIP has not been independently byte-verified.
The download contains 60 constructed-card entries. Its SHA-256 is <code>6317bff24f2856d38c4edade52c9b852e5430107d113d5dd3126efd210ca2a24</code>; the download bytes were retained. The article lists 60 constructed cards and 29 outside-deck cards. Each outside-deck XML identity is counted separately; a card outside the deck is placed in its own card-type group when it is not a Defensive Shield.

=== Printing choices ===
* 2x [[Mace Windu (V) (ALT) (Errata)]]: XML <nowiki>201_42</nowiki>. The published list says <nowiki>2x Mace Windu (AI) (V)</nowiki>. The linked AI/ALT belongs to the same card family and its engine gameplay record matches the ordinary image after excluding image-identity fields. The generic AI label does not identify either C-Slip layout; the ordinary published AI image is shown.
* 1x [[Threepio With His Parts Showing (AI)]]: XML <nowiki>11_14</nowiki>. The published list says <nowiki>1x Threepio With His Parts Showing (AI)</nowiki>. The linked AI/ALT belongs to the same card family and its engine gameplay record matches the ordinary image after excluding image-identity fields.
* 1x [[Qui-Gon Jinn's Lightsaber (V) (ALT)]]: XML <nowiki>221_70</nowiki>. The published list says <nowiki>1x Qui-Gon Jinn’s Lightsaber (AI) (V)</nowiki>. The linked AI/ALT belongs to the same card family and its engine gameplay record matches the ordinary image after excluding image-identity fields.
